hero.lead: Multi-tenant accounts, credit billing and payments out of the box, with OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini compatible endpoints. Deploy once; your customers become tenants.

scenarios.title: One base, two ways to run it
scenarios.lead: You self-deploy one instance; your customers are its tenants and users. Flat, clear, ready out of the box.

ootb.d: Run Actionow as the backend for your tool: customers are tenants, with login, credits, billing, and a self-service console built in. No account system to rebuild.

relay.d: Resell model access NewAPI-style: customers call your instance with the OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini SDK, priced per token. Your margin sits on top of upstream cost.

features.title: Everything it takes to run an AI platform

protocol.d: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini dialects interconvert, with tool calls, multimodal, and streaming.

selfservice.d: Customers register, create and rotate keys, check usage, and top up themselves, no hand-holding.

pricing.d: Set input / output prices per model; the spread over upstream cost is your resale margin.

routing.d: Hang many upstream channels behind one model name: weighted routing, automatic failover, per-request credentials.

billing.d: µcredit-precise metering, auditable hold to settle; Stripe, Alipay, WeChat, crypto top-ups and redemption codes.

logs.d: Per-call logs with usage and latency; the operator sees everything, each tenant sees only their own.

s1.d: Bring one up with docker compose and seed the operator admin account.

s2.d: Register models, attach upstream channels and credentials, set token prices and tenant visibility.

s3.d: Customers register as tenants, get keys and top up themselves, and call the compatible endpoints.

pricing.title: You self-host, you set the price
pricing.lead: Actionow is your own base: resale prices, discounts, and data all stay with you. Open-source scaffold, self-hosted on your terms.

self.d: One-command docker deploy; data and pricing fully your own.

support.d: Deployment help, custom upstream adapters, and reconciliation reports.

cta.title: Put an AI gateway inside your own infrastructure
cta.lead: Deploy a multi-tenant, metered, protocol-translating base in minutes.
